content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Deploy a complete digital commerce stack in 24 hours. No servers. No monthly fees. No geographic restrictions. Use GitHub Pages for hosting. Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Supabase for order storage. Google Drive for file delivery. NOWPayments for crypto payments. This stack is live the moment you deploy it. Load your first product. Test the flow. Take your first transaction. Every tool is free or low-cost. Every component is yours to own. No platform can shut you down. No payment processor can lock you out. This is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. Built for creators in Ghana. Built for creators who need sovereignty.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

Start with GitHub Pages. Host your storefront. Zero cost. Global CDN. Instant deployment. Use Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Write serverless functions. Handle order processing. Trigger file delivery. Supabase stores your orders. Free tier. Scalable. Secure. Google Drive delivers your files. Direct download links. No bandwidth fees. NOWPayments handles crypto payments. 300+ currencies. 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts. This stack is lean. This stack is fast. This stack is yours. Deploy today. Sell tomorrow. Own forever.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

You do not need a custom domain. Use GitHub Pages’ default URL. You do not need email marketing. Use direct links. You do not need analytics. Track sales manually. Focus on the core: hosting, payments, delivery. Everything else is secondary. Deploy the stack. Load your product. Test the flow. Take your first sale. Optimize later. Scale later. The goal is sovereignty. The goal is ownership. The goal is selling today.
Deploy your stack in 24 hours. No servers. No subscriptions.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Deploy your stack. Load your product into Google Drive. Generate a shareable link. Configure NOWPayments for your crypto wallet. Test the flow. Buy your own product. Verify delivery. Fix any issues. Go live. Share your storefront link. Take your first sale. This is not a simulation. This is real commerce. Real revenue. Real sovereignty. Your stack is live. Your product is selling. Your infrastructure is yours.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Own your infrastructure. No platform can shut you down.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for GitHub and create a new repository for your storefront. 2. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages. 3. Set up a Cloudflare Workers account for backend logic. 4. Create a Supabase project for order storage. 5. Upload your product to Google Drive and generate a shareable link. 6. Register for NOWPayments and configure your crypto wallet. 7. Test the entire flow by purchasing your own product. 8. Share your storefront link and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in Ghana?
Yes. This stack works globally. No geographic restrictions. Deploy today. Sell tomorrow.
Do I need to know how to code?
Basic understanding of HTML and JavaScript helps. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for faster deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON.
Can I add more products later?
Yes. The stack is scalable. Add products to Google Drive. Update your storefront. No additional costs.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
You own the infrastructure. Switch to another payment processor. No platform lock-in.
